nom: The Crème Shop Miffy Clear As Day Blemish Patches

avis.texte: Didnt absorb like patches with just hydrocolloid do and caused a red patch in the shape of Miffy that's lasting a few days now

I was very impressed when I took off the psych and the pimple under was completely gone. The patches themselves are a little big so they seem to be good on bigger pimples too. It stayed on until I took it off. Overall I like them, bonus points because it kept my toddle interested in my face because they watch Miffy

avis.titre: Not only are these adorable, but they work!
avis.texte: The packaging is so fun and feels like a pick me up vs the dreaded reason you need a pimple patch. My daughter and I had so many people stop and ask us what we used and they loved it. Further, these work so well. Pimples stood zero chance over here. Definitely buying more!

avis.titre: Super cute, but not the most effective
avis.texte: I received this product at no cost in exchange for a review. I've tried a handful of other blemish patches. These Miffy ones are definitely the cutest ones I've tried, but there are other brands that were more effective in decreasing the size of my breakout. I think these Miffy ones could be cute as a cover up for if you want to go out while hiding a blemish.
I used the product on my noticeable blemishes and overnight it looked a ton better. My skin is softer and the spots gradually went.
These are cute patches especially for the younger teens. They do get the work done by getting the junk out from a pimple.

My Review of Miffy Clear as Day! Blemish Patch: I was honestly surprised by how well these little patches worked. I popped one on a stubborn pimple before bed, and by morning, the redness and swelling had noticeably gone down. They're super easy to use, stay put through the night, and don't irritate my skin at all. I love that they have Tea Tree and Witch Hazel which made my skin felt calmer, less oily, and just overall clearer. It's become my go-to anytime a breakout pops up.
Cute cute cute, they stick nicely and I don't mind wearing them out in public. Easy to spot other Miffy fans lol

I was surprised at how well these patches actually work. Within 24 hours my visible pimples had started to disappear all together plus the stickers are so fun and cute and peel off the package really easily.
I used this a couple of times now to give it a chance, and honestly didn't notice any improvement or changes.

So, at first I was a bit skeptical since I'd never used these kinds of patches. Buuuut I absolutely think they 1. Helped me be able to wear clothes with a cleavage (since I got a pimple on my chest), 2. Made it actually very cute! Since having these little sweet stickers is adorable 3. I think it actually helped it heal A LITTLE quicker.
These miffy style blemish patches are so adorable and are a great way to cover and treat at the same time .
Effectively reduced blemishes and prevented further irritation. Great for a small pimple flare up. Add a touch a whimsy to your skin care routine with the fun designs!

avis.titre: They were cute but didn't help my skin
avis.texte: The patches were cute but unfortunately they didn't seem to help my skin or acne at all
It's easy to use especially when you have those hard blemishes.

avis.titre: Feeling Cute in not so pretty situations.
avis.texte: When dealing with something not so pretty like pimples and blemishes, the Miffy Clear As Day! Blemish Patches by The Crème Shop somehow make me feel cute. The designs are absolutely adorable, with little flowers, fruit, and animals that honestly make me smile every time I see them. It might sound silly, but they brighten up my mood. Instead of hiding blemishes, I actually feel happy putting these on. They're fun, playful, and make the whole skincare process feel a little more cheerful. They also work really well. I wore three patches overnight and they stayed exactly where I put them. No peeling, no sliding around, just perfectly in place until I took them off in the morning. That gave me a lot of confidence knowing I could sleep comfortably without worrying. I would definitely recommend them to friends and family, and I'm already planning to buy more to use as cute and practical stocking stuffers. The Crème Shop sent me these *Miffy Clear As Day! Blemish Patches* for free through the BzzAgent sampling program so I could try them out and share my thoughts. Even though they were gifted, my opinions are totally honest. These patches made me feel better about my skin while actually helping it heal, and that's something I really appreciate.

I was very skeptical about this product. It looked more like thick stickers that a pimple path. I used one on my nose last night, I have oily skin, and it stayed on all night. No lifting or moving. Great gripping power. It's very satisfying to see all that gunk in the pimple patch.

the most amazing thing about this product is definitely the design. so many people stopped me to ask where i got the patches from. they're so cute! i love that i can wear them during the day since they're fashionable, as well as at night. they're really effective and i usually just need to use one to treat a pimple. i loved them and will be buying them again

avis.titre: Blemish Patches? More Like.. Miracle Patches!
avis.texte: These blemish patches are seriously a lifesaver! I just stick one on before bed, and by morning, my breakout is way less red and puffy. They stay in place all night and even during the day if I need extra healing time. Plus, they stop me from picking at my skin, which is a huge win. Super easy to use, totally aesthetic, and oddly satisfying to see how much gunk they pull out—definitely a must-have in my skincare routine! I'd definitely be willing to buy more in the future. I'd like to see different variations and styles of the patches.
I feel like they half work sometimes. They're not as good as the like regular ones but they're good for when its mostly out at the end

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. First of all, these pimple patches are ADORABLE!!! I have two toddlers who are constantly trying to peel these "stickers" off my face! I have resorted to using them after bed time so that I can actually reap the benefits of the patches. When I received these, I just happened to have a painful pimple under my nose. In just two uses, my pimple was brought to a head, and in the third, it sucked the yucky stuff out and it no longer hurt! It was flat and on its way to disappearing. Some of the patches are a little bigger, which I can see how that would be beneficial for cystic acne. Overall, they work just as good as other brands and are super cute! 10/10 would recommend!
I loved these patches so much. They are so adorable it makes you want to put them on. They work very very well and I saw results.

At the very least, The Crème Shop clear as day Miffy hydrocolloid blemish patches are cute. After using them a few times over night, I did not notice a difference in my acne spots. I think they're meant to cover them up so you don't mess with them while they are healing. I don't see hydrocolloid as an ingredient but maybe it's really called something different.
The product was good, but I wouldn't say great. It might work differently for different skin types and different types of acne.

avis.titre: Really cute, but way too big
avis.texte: I am maybe too old for the "rock your zit patches proudly in public" phase, but if that's your jam, these are for you. I wore one to bed and it worked fine, drying out a zit, but I wish there were more smaller ones rather than less in a pack of big ones.

avis.titre: I would buy this for myself and family.
avis.texte: These patches are just as good as any other ones that I've tried. I put the patches on overnight and some for two days (bigger blemishes) with good results. They damped any redness /inflammation and appeared smaller. I enjoy the designs of the patches though I wish there was more variety in sizes.
This pimple patch is so cute and works great especially when I needed it the most. I use this at night and the next day it my skin feels better (no pimple bump)

avis.titre: They're cute but not very effective
avis.texte: If you're a fan of the characters they'd be nice to have, but I didn't notice any improvement to blemishes. They did adhere pretty well and they're slightly larger than traditional patches because of the characters, so that could be a plus.

avis.titre: Blemish Patches of different sizes and a cute design
avis.texte: Blemish patches are great, and I don't know that we're going to find some new formulation that makes me excited to choose one over another, but these Miffy ones have some differences that I really like. I've used peach flesh toned ones, little hearts, and little stars all meant to be relatively discreet and not seen, and these are very conspicuous and brightly colored in the design. There are lots of different designs and sizes on the sheet, not just the tiny ones I would use for whiteheads, but Miffy is actually pretty big and great for if you have a cluster of blemishes or a scratch you want to heal etc that otherwise you'd have to cut down a large hydrocolloid patch for. Only this way, it gets to be cute. I think this is especially good for someone young who is trying to make sure nothing scars and would like something that feels more like they are wearing a cute face paint rather than a bandage. I've really taken recently to using things like these for any face issue to help prevent scarring. I got this product for free in exchange for an honest review.
i LOVE HOW WELL IT WORKED CLEARING MY SKIN but I didnt like how its a pretty big size bunny i gtta walk around withy stuck on my face lol, felt pretty silly if i were around anyone.

My daughter and I both tried out the Miffy Patches, but she was much more excited then I was. My pimple was more of a slow grow, and while this kept it at bay for a few days, it did not "pull it out" and get rid of it. My daughter loved the patches and used them a couple of times, and decided she's a fan and took the rest of the pack! They have a very cute design, and they are all the rage right now... I just wish it would get rid of the pimple for me at first sight!

This pimple patch is so cute. You will forget that you have a pulsing pimple under it when people start complimenting these patches on your face. Compared to the other brands out there, obviously this is more aesthetic to have on your face when you have a nasty pimple. Always satisfying peeling it off when the pus/oil comes out, except now its on Miffy.

These patches are super cute and the pack has a few sizes for those bigger blemishes! I have found them to be effective in absorbing the fluid from my pimples and they help prevent me from scratching or picking. The designs are super cute so your teenagers will love them! Overall they have been helping heal those unexpected pimples super fast!

Thank you Miffy for sending me this product! I absolutely love the design of the blemish patches. There are multiple sizes and designs which is perfect for switching it up based on the blemish size. The product itself works very well at removing the buildup from the blemishes. I wore mine overnight and was super impressed at how well it removed everything; the blemish was noticeably smaller and less inflamed the following day. I will note the patches are extra sticky too so they aren't budging!

I like the idea of this patches. They are fun and interesting. My kids seem to like them too. The stick well and provide enough of protection and support for a long time. After a whole night they still were firmly pressed to the skin. However, it is was a bit hard to peel off, and if I had more than one pimple to cover, the face looked too funny. They are cool for the house only. I cannot wear them outside, but they did their job. The pimple did not look inflamed after it.

avis.titre: Cute when you don't feel it!
avis.texte: I loved these so much! I don't get blemishes often, but when I do, it's so annoying and really puts a damper on my confidence. Although I probably wouldn't wear these out of the house, they were super cute for at home! They worked just as good as other patches I have tried and help my blemish clear up much faster!
I have hormonal acne here and there and these patches really help make them go away sooner! I'm so glad I was able to try these!
I received this product for free for my honest review. Product was easy to use and package nicely. However I did not notice much improvement when using the patches

These pimple patches are not only cute but they also work amazing. I put one on in the morning and it lasted me all day without peeling at all, so its very durable and it wont come off easily. Once i removed it I immediately noticed the difference, the pimple was completely gone. I could tell the patch was working because once on my skin I could already see the puss coming on the patch. 10/10 product will be recommending to others.

These blemish patches are so cute! They also are in a variety of sizes due to the shapes of the design. I did notice reduced redness on my pimple. I didn't have a pimple with a head to test the absorption of these patches.

They look so cute and they do their job! It's not magic of course but they help me not to pop my pimples. They look cute and compared to the regular patches I think I live these better because they look nice and the regular ones are not my favorite look
It barley stayed on, I applied it to clean dry skin but it would keep slipping and falling. So it's a no for me though the designs are super cute.

avis.titre: I would use theses again and again!
avis.texte: These pimple patches are not only cute but effective!! They get the gunk out without having to pop a pimple and end up with a scar!
I put one over night because I had a big pimple, next day it was all dried :)

avis.titre: Didn't work as well as others
avis.texte: These didn't seem to work as well as others I have used. They are very large also which is good sometimes but I also need smaller sizes and none come in the pack. They are cute designs though.

avis.titre: Love these things and they're cute
avis.texte: I absolutely love these pimple patches. Not only are these adorable and look cute to have on, but they're actually very effective with drawing out the nastiness in any pimple I have. I had a pimple on my chin that are always lingerers and tend to stick around for a while, I used one of these for two nights and it was gone! These are also a hit with my pre-teen nieces, it's like a fashion statement to wear these around at school, which they did, and they love them! I will definitely be purchasing more of these. These were super cute and fun but very effective. I like to wear them overnight before bed. They were really effective in making my pimples and breakouts disappear or go down. Overall a great product and didn't blemish my skin! I received this product for free to try.

avis.titre: I would buy it again for sure!
avis.texte: I love the colorful and unique patches and the range of sizes. I love the character themes and designs.The only thing I did dislike was it does take a while for it to sit there.

avis.titre: I would purchase this Miffy Patch again.
avis.texte: These patches are very cute and actually work really well. I followed the instructions, applied it to my pimple with a clean face. The patch sticks very well and feels light on my face. I felt like nothing was sticking to my face. I let it sit overnight, and in the morning, I removed the patch and the whitehead came off with it. I have used other brands too, but I think from now on I will stick with this Miffy patch. Highly recommended

So I used this product overnight after doing my night time routine, gentle cleanser, toner, serum, and moisturizer. I placed the patch directly over my blemish, and remove in the morning. My pimple was noticeably flatter and less red and inflamed looking. Would definitely purchase again!

I loved these blemish patches! Not only are they super cute (making breakouts feel less annoying), but they actually work. I noticed a big difference overnight - my pimple was visibly smaller and less red by morning. Plus, they stick really well and stay put, even through sleep. The only downside is that all the patches are on the larger side. I wish there were a few smaller sizes for tinier blemishes or more precise placement. But overall, they're effective and adorable!
I think this is great product it does the job and it's very cute. Make sure you have nothing on your face before you apply it because I won't stick as good

As someone who hates the feeling of things on my face I was concerned that the Miffy Clear As Day! Blemish Patches would be uncomfortable for me to wear, however, I put them on after my evening shower to leave until the next day as the instructions adviced and I didn't feel them at all! They also have very good staying power, at one point I started showering forgetting I'd put a patch on and only realized after I bumped my finger against it while cleansing my face. I put them over some of my larger inflamed pimples and personally I felt like when I took them off they definitely made the pimples much less noticeable and helped with the redness. They didn't leave a film after taking them off either which is another plus. All in all I find that the Miffy Clear As Day! Blemish Patches definitely perform as advertised and are worth at least a try!

I tried the Miffy Clear as Day blemish patches and it functioned so well overnight. I also think they're just super adorable and I kept looking at myself to smile. I recommend for dual purpose, it worked to clear my pimple before an event and I loved the size options. I received this product to try in exchange for my honest review.

These blemish patches are a total game-changer! I use them overnight, and by morning, any redness or swelling is significantly reduced. They stay put really well, even through tossing and turning. I love how discreet they are and how they help prevent me from picking at my skin. Plus, the cute packaging is a fun bonus. I wish the pack included more of the larger sizes, but overall, these are must-haves in my skincare routine.

I actually had quite a bit of acne to test these on at night and each morning my blemishes would be smaller. These are great if you've got a pimple brewing and want to be proactive. Plus they're cute!
These are really cute and work great. I put one on overnight and my pimple was so much smaller in the morning. It draws out all of the pus and shrinks the pimple. I love it.

These Miffy blemish patches work fast and look adorable while doing it. They stick well, stay on overnight, and help shrink spots without drying your skin out. Plus, the clear design blends in nicely and the Miffy packaging is just too cute to ignore. Great for breakouts that need a quiet fix.

Absolutely love the designs of the patches! Would put on at night and in the morning there was a big difference both visually and physically where they were applied. It was a bit painful to remove, especially for the largest ones, but I never had an issue with them peeling while I wore them (and I'd rather have the product stick a bit too well than not enough). For people looking for patches, I would definitely recommend these!

I received this as part of a campaign. They work really well— I woke up with the pimple completely flat and gone. The patches also stay on really well (almost hard to take off, but not in a painful way) which is great because some patches fall off way too easily. All in all, if you like the sticker-esque patches, I think these do wonderfully.
These worked so well and got rid of my blemishes overnight! They're also super cute and I loved all of the different sizing options!
Such cute and fun way to cover up a pimple! I noticeable saw reduced redness and size of blemish after using
I loved using these cute Miffy patches on my blemishes. They were so cute and comfortable to wear I almost forgot I was wearing them! They worked really well to clear up my few problem areas.

These are honestly some of the cutest pimple patches I've ever used! Not only do they look adorable on your skin, but they actually work really well at reducing redness and flattening blemishes overnight. I love that they're gentle and stay in place without irritating my skin. Such a fun way to treat breakouts while still feeling cute!

Disclosure: I received this product for free in exchange for an honest review. I've tried just about every blemish patch on the market, and most of them drive me insane. They either refuse to come off the backing (I've lost actual minutes of my life wrestling with those clear plastic sheets) or they slide off your face the second you exhale. These? Shockingly intentional. They peeled off cleanly—no static cling, no grabbing four at once, no landing somewhere between the paper and your cheekbone. It was precise, effortless, and...honestly kind of refreshing. I also loved the mix of sizes and shapes—finally something that acknowledges acne doesn't follow a standard template. And the playful little symbols gave me a much-needed laugh in the middle of what was otherwise a skin crisis. I wore a few overnight and noticed that while the patches stayed on securely, they were super gooey when I removed them in the morning. Not the end of the world... just worth noting if you hate that tacky residue. Would I buy them? Yes. Would I recommend them? Absolutely. Intentional, cute, and functional—easily one of the better ones I've tried.

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. This was my first pimple patch so my expectations were pretty low since I wanted to try it blindly. The characters are cute, it comes with a very good amount (21) and even recommends using for 6 hours/overnight for best results. I've had a stubborn chin-ple and this helped a great deal but not enough to produce an extraction but enough to calm the area. i experienced absolutely no irritation and even my little one thought it was cute. It shockingly didn't come off and retained stickiness when my little one tried to pull it too. Since I saw results and healing after the 6 hour mark and after, I'm gonna give this a 4. I hope there's more characters to purchase lol

I received a free sheet of Miffy Clear As Day Blemish Patches to Review. I love them. Great ingredients and they are super cute. You won't feel so bad having a pimple now. Thank you so much for letting me try these.

avis.titre: This is definitely a must buy. Great product
avis.texte: I used the patch overnight and it literally sucked out all my black and white heads. I've tried a few pimples patches and this one worked the best. Will definitely be getting more!

I want to start by stating these Miffy Clear As Day! Blemish Patches had my toddler in a tizzy. She wanted one every single time she saw the packaging. The bunnies are too cute to resist. So I'd advise you to keep them out of sight. I kept mine in the cabinet of my bathroom. So far I've used six - two a day. Three on the same pimple. I use as directed on bare skin and after two days, I noticed the bump on my neck coming to the surface. Today I extracted what I could and popped another patch on top. I used one on a pimple I'd already tried extracting but noticed it still had something under the skin. By the next day, the patch was full and the pimple is gone. Flat and barely noticeable that it was there. So today, I placed one on my forehead, another stubborn pimple. The last one was used on day one under my chin. I noticed that pimple was gone within 12 hours. So I'd say these are pretty effective overall. I think they work better on pimples that have already come to a head or extracted and need a little not help to go away. The one pimple on my neck that I've used three patches on was under the skin. I've used other brands that would wipe it out with one patch overnight - hydrocolloid as well. So that's why I docked these a star. I love that these are stuck once they're in place. I was even able to do my makeup and night time routine wearing them with no issues. My husband thought I let our daughter out stickers on my face. So that was a segue to explain what they were. I'll

I've used several acne patches brands, and I'm being totally honest when I say these ones were one of the best I've ever tried. They stayed stuck and did not lift or peel, and it sucked so much gunk out! I love this cute little characters and the different sizes you can choose from. These were pretty great and I know I'll be buying again.
